Hi everyone! Just received my plants today and felt obliged to post some pictures! Calen really is a true pro and I hope the plants enjoy my conditions as much as they clearly enjoyed his! One thing that stood out above other shipments I've received - root health, all these plants had extremely healthy, long roots which were in better health than really any plants I've seen which I am guessing results in their vigor!

Box full of goodness!



Awesome packing! Even the developing pitchers were not damaged, which is more than I can say for most shipments I've received



All potted up, ready for some sun!

It's been a long time since I've posted on the forum, but I decided that I absolutely need to share a pic of the plants I received from Calen. I ordered a flava cuprea BH and flava atropurpurea F27 - and got a freebie of atropurpurea F27 x Waccamaw as well!

4" pot on the left for scale - these are absolutely the largest plants I've ever received from an online order. BH on left, F27 in middle, and F27 x Waccamaw on the right. Just as a note, the white spot on the BH is not mealybugs or any other pests - just a small bleached spot on the leaf. I'd highly recommend buying one (or multiple) of Calen's plants! 




Attachments:

posts.body_html:
I would like to pile on to what others are saying about Calen's plants.  I do need to say that he sometime's gets his sizes mixed up -- a couple of the "large size" plants I bought might have been large last October or last March, but they have grown a bit since then.  One XL flava I got looked more like a mother plant and I paid less than half what it has been listed for at a commercial grower.

And he has some very, very good seedlings, I am VERY happy.  I like people who keep good records of their crosses and the plants they get from others.  A big e-bay seller once told me to look up his plants on CP Photofinder if I wanted to find out their pedigrees.

Way to go Calen!  Love those roots, man!
